rarities.description: A Red-backed Shrike (Lanius collurio) was recorded in Kumta by birders during the Karnataka Rajyotsava Bird Count (held October 30–November 2, 2026) as a state first record.
A Common Ringed Plover (Charadrius hiaticula) was recorded in Gokarna by Shwetha Bharathi as a state first record.
A Common Chiffchaff (Phylloscopus collybita) was recorded in Kumta & Bangalore by Shwetha Bharathi & Sourav Mandal respectively on November 16th and 17th.
